complexity.notes: The only change from the previous submission is removing the debug print, which also makes the `import math` line now dead — it can be dropped. `sorted(zip(position, speed))` would build the same list more idiomatically than the indexed comprehension. The algorithm is already the standard optimal one for this problem.
complexity.summary: Sorts the cars by position, then walks from closest-to-target outward, comparing each car's arrival time against the current lead fleet's arrival time: cars that arrive no later are absorbed, otherwise a new fleet is counted and becomes the lead.
